transcript.title: Gaius x city hall legal office - discovery (sample)

summary.overview: Call with the head of a city hall legal office. 15 legal advisers, a lot of public procurement and freedom-of-information requests. Conditions: data must stay on the city's infrastructure and every answer needs its legal basis. They compare Gaius with Legalis and Microsoft Copilot.

sentences.text: We have fifteen legal advisers and a flood of freedom-of-information requests.
What is your condition for a rollout?
Data cannot leave our servers. We tested Copilot, but IT said no.
